hypotheses.name: Adaptive continuity without salience lock-in
hypotheses.hypothesis: Utility-guided salience improves next-decision quality only when gain/inhibition/diversity controls prevent self-confirming attractors.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Any apparent gain is repeated exposure/retrieval bias and eventually narrows useful alternatives.
hypotheses.falsifier: Truthful adaptive field fails to beat frozen truthful field or diversity controls remove the gain.
hypotheses.experiment: online truthful vs frozen vs reward-poisoned salience with bounded gain/inhibition/diversity reserve

hypotheses.name: Nested workspace mediation
hypotheses.hypothesis: Part of system WorkspaceEpisode benefit is mediated by a privileged model-internal uptake plane in the target Qwen reader.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Ordinary distributed transformer computation explains behavior with no privileged mediator.
hypotheses.falsifier: Targeted internal-workspace lesion leaves system-workspace effect unchanged.
hypotheses.experiment: exact-Qwen system-workspace x internal-workspace lesion/swap x re-entry factorial

hypotheses.name: External recurrence rescue
hypotheses.hypothesis: Truthful provenance-bound re-entry selectively rescues multi-step performance when internal workspace is limited.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched shuffled/temporally invalid re-entry rescues equally.
hypotheses.experiment: internal-workspace lesion x truthful/shuffled/off re-entry with token/content matching

hypotheses.name: Unknown closure is a topology state
hypotheses.hypothesis: UNKNOWN dependency closure must be represented explicitly in causal/topological state and should broaden or isolate coupling rather than be treated as valid scope.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Runtime hidden dependencies are rare enough that narrow validation remains safe without explicit unknown state.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target traces show complete closure or no unsafe accept difference under unknown-aware fallback.
hypotheses.experiment: trace-driven hidden-dependency injection with scoped vs unknown-aware validation

hypotheses.name: Higher-order representation without higher propagation gain
hypotheses.hypothesis: N-ary/hyperedge representation improves semantic fidelity while propagation depth/gain must remain independently bounded to avoid oversmoothing/noise.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Higher-order relations require stronger propagation to realize benefit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Bounded propagation loses the higher-order benefit while stronger propagation improves OOD utility without collapse.
hypotheses.experiment: pairwise vs role-nary topology crossed with propagation gain/depth/diversity

hypotheses.name: Typed candidate topology precedes workspace
hypotheses.hypothesis: Collection/query semantics can dominate downstream workspace effects by altering candidate topology before competition.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Real FRANK workloads are insensitive to realistic collection/lowering choices.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target candidate sets remain invariant under semantically equivalent multi-engine lowering.
hypotheses.experiment: cross-engine TCQS differential lowering tied to candidate/workspace hashes

hypotheses.name: Authority remains orthogonal to utility and workspace
hypotheses.hypothesis: Deterministic effect-broker mediation prevents salience/workspace/model utility from expanding authority even under reward poisoning or prompt injection.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Semantic typing plus model alignment is sufficient without hard broker mediation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Broker-free arm matches attack resistance and revocation correctness under identical outputs.
hypotheses.experiment: effect-broker attack matrix with identical model proposals and revocation races
